xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe: Notes pertaining to Statement of Standalone Audited Results for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2024: 1. Net premium income is net of reinsurance. 2. Income from investments (Net) is net of amortisation and losses (including capital gains). 3. Net Commission is net of reinsurance. Rewards have been included in First year commission. 4. Benefits Paid (Net) is net of reinsurance and inclusive of interim and terminal bonus. 5. Expenses other than those related to insurance business includes Remuneration of MD/CEOs/WTDs over specifed limits and interest on Non convertible debentures. 6. Provisions for diminution in value of investments is inclusive of provision for standard and non-standard assets. 7. Profit carried to Balance Sheet represents accumulated surplus. 8. Analytical ratios have been calculated as per definition given in IRDAI Analytical ratios disclosure. 9. Profit after tax comprises: Underwriting profits Q2 (a) Existing business surplus (i) 1,33,110 (b) New business strain (ii) (1,13,631) Shareholders' surplus (iii) 23,830 H1 (a) Existing business surplus (i) 2,74,711 (b) New business strain (ii) (2,29,028) Shareholders' surplus (iii) 45,381 (i) Represents profit emerging during current period from business written in prior years (ii) Insurance contracts being long term in nature revenue is recognised over the period of the contract as against costs being recognised in the period in which they are incurred, leading to New business strain. (iii) Represents investment and other income arising on shareholders' funds, net of expenses and taxes
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesToBalanceShee: Notes to Cashflow: 1. Payments to reinsurer, net of commissions and claims/ benefits and Payments of claims/benefits clubbed together in the line item receipts for premium and claims, annuities and other policy benefits 2. Payments of commission, brokerage and payments of other operating expenses has been clubbed under other cash payments from operating activities 4. GST paid is clubbed under other outflows of cash under operating activities. 5. Purchase of Investment and Investment in money market instruments and liquid mutual fund is clubbed under head other cash payments to acquire equity or debt instruments under Investing actvities. 6. Proceeds from issuance of share capital and share application money is clubbed in line item proceeds from issuance of shares. 7. Breakup of cash and cash equivalents and reconciliation with cash and bank balance as per LODR not shown as the same is not part of format in the current utility.
